title: Application Fails After EC2 Instance Reboot
symptom: EC2 instance rebooted cleanly, but application is down and website returns connection refused.
initial_observations: systemctl is-enabled shows 'disabled' for the service.

possible_causes.cause: Service unit was never enabled for autostart across reboots
possible_causes.remediation: Run `sudo systemctl enable myapp` and `sudo systemctl start myapp`.

investigation_steps.title: Check Service Autostart State
investigation_steps.explanation: Check if unit has symlink in multi-user.target.wants.
